content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and industrial brake parts for construction and OEMs; not vehicle protection films or coatings for installers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies, test equipment and outsourced supply chain services; no vehicle film or coating products."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting consumables and equipment for fabricators and shipyards; different products and industrial customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Municipal specialty vehicles, sirens and public safety systems sold to government agencies; not protective films for vehicle owners."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for construction and composites; different products and customers from vehicle films."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Mostly OEM, industrial, aerospace and architectural coatings; automotive refinish overlaps, but core business differs from installed protection film."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Metalworking fluids, lubricants and process chemicals for industrial plants; no vehicle protection film or coating business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments sold to building owners and utilities; different products and customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Industrial locks, hinges and metal castings sold to equipment makers; hardware components, not protective films or coatings."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers and water instruments sold to manufacturers and utilities; different products and customers."}]}
